verify_detail: tart of every 5-launch cycle since the last data clear/reinstall. It has nothing to do with timing, network, or randomness — a test suite that runs launches back-to-back without resetting app data (or that happens to land on the 3rd/5th run of a cycle) will deterministically hit the buttonless state ~2 times out of 5, exactly the observed 3/5 pass rate. Fix/mitigation: either have the test clear app data before each run, or fix the app to not gate button visibility on a rotating launch counter.'
